title: Scalable Incremental Robustness Analysis of Neural Network Feedback Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.22576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semidefinite programming (SDP) certificates for feedback systems containing deep neural networks (NNs) typically scale with the total number of neurons, whereas small-gain tests are scalable but can be highly conservative. This paper develops a unified and scalable framework for incremental robust stability and performance analysis of feedback interconnections involving high-dimensional NNs and unmodeled dynamics. By combining a structured decomposition of the full-order SDP condition with scalable Lipschitz constant estimation algorithms, we derive reduced verification conditions that certify incremental convergence and incremental $\ell_2$-gain bounds. The dimensions of the resulting control-analysis linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) depend only on the widths of the last two network layers and are \textit{independent of network depth}. translated_title: 神经网络反馈系统的可扩展增量鲁棒性分析
translated_abstract: 包含深度神经网络（NN）的反馈系统的半定规划（SDP）证书通常随神经元总数而扩展，而小增益测试虽然具有可扩展性但可能非常保守。本文开发了一个统一且可扩展的框架，用于对涉及高维神经网络和未建模动态的反馈互联系统进行增量鲁棒稳定性与性能分析。通过将全阶SDP条件的结构化分解与可扩展的Lipschitz常数估计算法相结合，我们推导出简化的验证条件，用于证明增量收敛性和增量 $\ell_2$-增益界。所得的控制分析线性矩阵不等式（LMI）的维数仅取决于网络最后两层的宽度，且与网络深度无关。该框架保留了被控对象与神经网络之间的耦合，通过增量小增益……
tldr: 本文提出一个统一可扩展的框架，通过将全阶SDP条件的结构化分解与可扩展的Lipschitz常数估计算法相结合，使神经网络反馈系统的增量鲁棒性验证条件的LMI维数仅取决于网络最后两层的宽度而与网络深度无关，同时保留被控对象与神经网络间的耦合。
